title: 大跨度空間桁架提升
subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
summary: 大跨度屋蓋若在高空逐件安裝，需要大量臨時支撐、高空作業與大型吊車；改在地面組裝後整體提升，能提高品質與安全，但提升狀態下桁架的支承點、受力方向與穩定條件都和使用狀態不同。課程以倫敦希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋、新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的 1,270 t 提升，以及川口衞發展、1984 年首用於神戶世界紀念館的 Pantadome 頂升構法為錨點，說明吊點與吊耳、鋼絞線與千斤頂、同步控制、塔架穩定、試提升、風速停止準則與就位轉換的檢核邏輯。
summaryEn: Erecting a long-span roof piece by piece at height needs extensive falsework, work at height and large cranes; assembling it at ground level and lifting it whole improves quality and safety, but in the lifting state the truss has different supports, force directions and stability conditions from service. Anchored on the 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5, the 1,270 t lift of the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark and Mamoru Kawaguchi's Pantadome push-up method first used at Kobe's World Memorial Hall in 1984, the course explains the checking logic for lift points and lugs, strands and jacks, synchronised control, tower stability, trial lifts, wind stop criteria and final load transfer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升」與「提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Why assemble at ground level and lift whole" and "Lifting state versus service state": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Why assemble at ground level and lift whole: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「地面組裝與整體提升」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ground assembly and integral lift” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大跨度空間桁架在高空逐件安裝時，每個節點都要臨時支撐、高空焊接與檢驗，品質與安全都難控制；若改在地面或低處組裝成大單元，再以多台千斤頂同步提升，可以在穩定的工作面完成焊接、塗裝甚至部分機電與屋面。希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋就因機場雷達限制不能使用高大吊車，而在地面組裝後頂升到位；Pantadome 構法則把屋頂中央部分在低處組裝，再以推升機構把可折疊的結構撐到最終形狀。選擇方法時要同時比較臨時工程、提升設備、工期與風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「地面組裝與整體提升」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Erecting a long-span space truss piece by piece at height means temporary support, welding and inspection at every node in the air, making quality and safety hard to control; assembling large units at or near ground level and lifting them with several synchronised jacks lets welding, painting and even some services and roofing be done on a stable working surface. The 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5 was assembled on the ground and jacked into place because airport radar ruled out tall cranes; the Pantadome method assembles the central part of a dome low down and pushes the foldable structure up into its final shape. Choosing a method means comparing temporary works, lifting equipment, programme and risk together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ground assembly and integral lift” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：公開資料指出第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段、每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Published accounts give the Terminal 5 roof as 6 sections of about 2,200 t, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「地面組裝與整體提升」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Ground assembly and integral lift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升
knowledge.titleEn: Why assemble at ground level and lift whole
knowledge.text: 大跨度空間桁架在高空逐件安裝時，每個節點都要臨時支撐、高空焊接與檢驗，品質與安全都難控制；若改在地面或低處組裝成大單元，再以多台千斤頂同步提升，可以在穩定的工作面完成焊接、塗裝甚至部分機電與屋面。希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋就因機場雷達限制不能使用高大吊車，而在地面組裝後頂升到位；Pantadome 構法則把屋頂中央部分在低處組裝，再以推升機構把可折疊的結構撐到最終形狀。
knowledge.textEn: Erecting a long-span space truss piece by piece at height means temporary support, welding and inspection at every node in the air, making quality and safety hard to control; assembling large units at or near ground level and lifting them with several synchronised jacks lets welding, painting and even some services and roofing be done on a stable working surface. The 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5 was assembled on the ground and jacked into place because airport radar ruled out tall cranes; the Pantadome method assembles the central part of a dome low down and pushes the foldable structure up into its final shape.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「大跨度空間桁架提升」的「為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「高樓模型整合室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Why assemble at ground level and lift whole: mechanism and load path” in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tower model integration room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Why assemble at ground level and lift whole" is correct?
options: 整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。
大跨度空間桁架在高空逐件安裝時，每個節點都要臨時支撐、高空焊接與檢驗，品質與安全都難控制。
提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。
optionsEn: Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change.
Erecting a long-span space truss piece by piece at height means temporary support, welding and inspection at every node in the air, making quality and safety hard to control.
During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe.
quiz.explanation: 大跨度空間桁架在高空逐件安裝時，每個節點都要臨時支撐、高空焊接與檢驗，品質與安全都難控制；若改在地面或低處組裝成大單元，再以多台千斤頂同步提升，可以在穩定的工作面完成焊接、塗裝甚至部分機電與屋面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Erecting a long-span space truss piece by piece at height means temporary support, welding and inspection at every node in the air, making quality and safety hard to control; assembling large units at or near ground level and lifting them with several synchronised jacks lets welding, painting and even some services and roofing be done on a stable working surface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Why assemble at ground level and lift whole: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地面組裝與整體提升」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ground assembly and integral lift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：公開資料指出第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段、每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升。每台平均荷載 2,200×9.81/16 ≈ 1,350 kN；若選用單台容量 5,700 kN 的鋼絞線千斤頂（VSL 公布的上限），利用率約 24%。實際千斤頂型號與容量未公開，此處容量比較為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Published accounts give the Terminal 5 roof as 6 sections of about 2,200 t, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each. The mean load per jack is 2,200×9.81/16 ≈ 1,350 kN; with strand jacks of 5,700 kN each (the upper unit capacity published by VSL) the utilisation would be about 24%. The actual jack models and capacities are not public, so the capacity comparison is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以方案比較表列出高空散裝、分段吊裝與整體提升在臨時支撐量、高空作業工時、設備、工期與風險上的差異；選定整體提升後，確認永久柱或臨時塔架能承受提升反力，基礎與樓板的承載也在提升前完成檢核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a method comparison table to set out the differences between piece-by-piece erection at height, sectional crane lifts and integral lifting in falsework quantity, work-at-height hours, equipment, programme and risk; once integral lifting is chosen, confirm that permanent columns or temporary towers can take the lifting reactions and that foundations and slabs are checked before lifting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 公開資料指出第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段、每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升。每台平均荷載 2,200×9.81/16 ≈ 1,350 kN；若選用單台容量 5,700 kN 的鋼絞線千斤頂（VSL 公布的上限），利用率約 24%。實際千斤頂型號與容量未公開，此處容量比較為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Published accounts give the Terminal 5 roof as 6 sections of about 2,200 t, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each. The mean load per jack is 2,200×9.81/16 ≈ 1,350 kN; with strand jacks of 5,700 kN each (the upper unit capacity published by VSL) the utilisation would be about 24%. The actual jack models and capacities are not public, so the capacity comparison is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Why assemble at ground level and lift whole", which statement holds?
options: 鋼絞線千斤頂的容量夠大，鋼絞線可以無限次重複使用。
臨時塔架只要能承受千斤頂的豎向力就足夠。
公開資料指出第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段、每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升。
optionsEn: If the strand jack has enough capacity, strands can be reused indefinitely.
A temporary tower is adequate as long as it carries the jacks' vertical force.
Published accounts give the Terminal 5 roof as 6 sections of about 2,200 t, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料指出第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段、每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Published accounts give the Terminal 5 roof as 6 sections of about 2,200 t, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Why assemble at ground level and lift whole: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地面組裝與整體提升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ground assembly and integral lift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以方案比較表列出高空散裝、分段吊裝與整體提升在臨時支撐量、高空作業工時、設備、工期與風險上的差異；選定整體提升後，確認永久柱或臨時塔架能承受提升反力，基礎與樓板的承載也在提升前完成檢核。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a method comparison table to set out the differences between piece-by-piece erection at height, sectional crane lifts and integral lifting in falsework quantity, work-at-height hours, equipment, programme and risk; once integral lifting is chosen, confirm that permanent columns or temporary towers can take the lifting reactions and that foundations and slabs are checked before lifting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：整體提升的可行性要在初步設計階段就與結構設計同步評估，提升點位置、提升反力與臨時塔架基礎都應出現在設計圖說中；提升方法變更屬設計變更，須由結構設計者重新核算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The feasibility of integral lifting should be assessed alongside structural design from preliminary design, with lifting points, reactions and temporary tower foundations shown on the drawings; a change of lifting method is a design change that the structural designer must recheck.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只因工期而選擇整體提升，卻沒有把提升設備、塔架與基礎納入設計，可能在提升前才發現柱頂或樓板無法承受集中反力，被迫臨時補強；反之在受限場地堅持高空散裝，高空焊接品質不穩，安全風險也大增。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Choosing integral lifting for programme alone without designing lifting equipment, towers and foundations can reveal only just before lifting that column heads or slabs cannot take the concentrated reactions, forcing emergency strengthening; insisting on piece-by-piece erection at height on a constrained site gives inconsistent high-level welds and much greater safety risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以方案比較表列出高空散裝、分段吊裝與整體提升在臨時支撐量、高空作業工時、設備、工期與風險上的差異；選定整體提升後，確認永久柱或臨時塔架能承受提升反力，基礎與樓板的承載也在提升前完成檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Use a method comparison table to set out the differences between piece-by-piece erection at height, sectional crane lifts and integral lifting in falsework quantity, work-at-height hours, equipment, programme and risk; once integral lifting is chosen, confirm that permanent columns or temporary towers can take the lifting reactions and that foundations and slabs are checked before lifting.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 整體提升的可行性要在初步設計階段就與結構設計同步評估，提升點位置、提升反力與臨時塔架基礎都應出現在設計圖說中；提升方法變更屬設計變更，須由結構設計者重新核算。
knowledge.textEn: The feasibility of integral lifting should be assessed alongside structural design from preliminary design, with lifting points, reactions and temporary tower foundations shown on the drawings; a change of lifting method is a design change that the structural designer must recheck.

quiz.question: 要驗證「為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Why assemble at ground level and lift whole"?
options: 以方案比較表列出高空散裝、分段吊裝與整體提升在臨時支撐量、高空作業工時、設備、工期與風險上的差異。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
提升單元很重，風吹不動它，所以風速不必監測。
optionsEn: Use a method comparison table to set out the differences between piece-by-piece erection at height, sectional crane lifts and integral lifting in falsework quantity, work-at-height hours, equipment, programme and risk.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The lifting unit is so heavy that wind cannot move it, so wind need not be monitored.
quiz.explanation: 以方案比較表列出高空散裝、分段吊裝與整體提升在臨時支撐量、高空作業工時、設備、工期與風險上的差異；選定整體提升後，確認永久柱或臨時塔架能承受提升反力，基礎與樓板的承載也在提升前完成檢核。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a method comparison table to set out the differences between piece-by-piece erection at height, sectional crane lifts and integral lifting in falsework quantity, work-at-height hours, equipment, programme and risk; once integral lifting is chosen, confirm that permanent columns or temporary towers can take the lifting reactions and that foundations and slabs are checked before lifting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Why assemble at ground level and lift whole: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地面組裝與整體提升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ground assembly and integral lift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只因工期而選擇整體提升，卻沒有把提升設備、塔架與基礎納入設計，可能在提升前才發現柱頂或樓板無法承受集中反力，被迫臨時補強；反之在受限場地堅持高空散裝，高空焊接品質不穩，安全風險也大增。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing integral lifting for programme alone without designing lifting equipment, towers and foundations can reveal only just before lifting that column heads or slabs cannot take the concentrated reactions, forcing emergency strengthening; insisting on piece-by-piece erection at height on a constrained site gives inconsistent high-level welds and much greater safety risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：選擇方法時要同時比較臨時工程、提升設備、工期與風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Choosing a method means comparing temporary works, lifting equipment, programme and risk together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只因工期而選擇整體提升，卻沒有把提升設備、塔架與基礎納入設計，可能在提升前才發現柱頂或樓板無法承受集中反力，被迫臨時補強；反之在受限場地堅持高空散裝，高空焊接品質不穩，安全風險也大增。
knowledge.textEn: Choosing integral lifting for programme alone without designing lifting equipment, towers and foundations can reveal only just before lifting that column heads or slabs cannot take the concentrated reactions, forcing emergency strengthening; insisting on piece-by-piece erection at height on a constrained site gives inconsistent high-level welds and much greater safety risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Why assemble at ground level and lift whole" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只因工期而選擇整體提升，卻沒有把提升設備、塔架與基礎納入設計，可能在提升前才發現柱頂或樓板無法承受集中反力，被迫臨時補強。
提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Choosing integral lifting for programme alone without designing lifting equipment, towers and foundations can reveal only just before lifting that column heads or slabs cannot take the concentrated reactions, forcing emergency strengthening.
During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe.
quiz.explanation: 若只因工期而選擇整體提升，卻沒有把提升設備、塔架與基礎納入設計，可能在提升前才發現柱頂或樓板無法承受集中反力，被迫臨時補強；反之在受限場地堅持高空散裝，高空焊接品質不穩，安全風險也大增。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Choosing integral lifting for programme alone without designing lifting equipment, towers and foundations can reveal only just before lifting that column heads or slabs cannot take the concentrated reactions, forcing emergency strengthening; insisting on piece-by-piece erection at height on a constrained site gives inconsistent high-level welds and much greater safety risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lifting state versus service state: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「提升點與受力反轉」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift points and force reversal” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 提升時桁架只由少數吊點支承，吊點位置常與最終支座不同，有時還會內縮形成懸臂，桁架的彎矩分布因此改變。使用狀態中受壓的上弦，在吊點附近可能轉為受拉；原本受拉的下弦或斜桿則可能轉為受壓，而這些桿件原本只依受拉設計，細長比可能不足以抵抗挫屈。所以每一個提升階段都要把結構當成一個新的結構系統來分析，包括動力係數、吊點不同步與風載，而不是只看最終狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「提升點與受力反轉」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During lifting the truss rests on only a few lift points, often located differently from its final supports and sometimes set inward to form cantilevers, so the bending-moment distribution changes. A top chord in compression in service may go into tension near a lift point, while a bottom chord or diagonal designed for tension may go into compression with a slenderness never intended to resist buckling. Every lifting stage must therefore be analysed as a new structural system, including dynamic factors, unsynchronised lift points and wind, rather than checking the final state alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lift points and force reversal” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：桁架等效為長 120 m、w = 100 kN/m 的梁。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Treat the truss as a 120 m beam with w = 100 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「提升點與受力反轉」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lift points and force reversal”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異
knowledge.text: 提升時桁架只由少數吊點支承，吊點位置常與最終支座不同，有時還會內縮形成懸臂，桁架的彎矩分布因此改變。使用狀態中受壓的上弦，在吊點附近可能轉為受拉；原本受拉的下弦或斜桿則可能轉為受壓，而這些桿件原本只依受拉設計，細長比可能不足以抵抗挫屈。
knowledge.textEn: During lifting the truss rests on only a few lift points, often located differently from its final supports and sometimes set inward to form cantilevers, so the bending-moment distribution changes. A top chord in compression in service may go into tension near a lift point, while a bottom chord or diagonal designed for tension may go into compression with a slenderness never intended to resist buckling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lifting state versus service state" is correct?
options: 提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。
吊耳只是臨時配件，隨便焊上去就可以。
提升時桁架只由少數吊點支承，吊點位置常與最終支座不同，有時還會內縮形成懸臂，桁架的彎矩分布因此改變。
optionsEn: During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe.
Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way.
During lifting the truss rests on only a few lift points, often located differently from its final supports and sometimes set inward to form cantilevers, so the bending-moment distribution changes.
quiz.explanation: 提升時桁架只由少數吊點支承，吊點位置常與最終支座不同，有時還會內縮形成懸臂，桁架的彎矩分布因此改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During lifting the truss rests on only a few lift points, often located differently from its final supports and sometimes set inward to form cantilevers, so the bending-moment distribution changes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lifting state versus service state: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「提升點與受力反轉」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lift points and force reversal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：桁架等效為長 120 m、w = 100 kN/m 的梁。使用狀態兩端簡支，跨中 M = wL²/8 = 180,000 kN·m；提升時吊點各內縮 20 m，吊點處負彎矩 M = −w·20²/2 = −20,000 kN·m，跨中變為 w·80²/8 − 20,000 = 60,000 kN·m。吊點附近上弦由受壓轉為受拉、下弦轉為受壓。尺寸與荷載為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Treat the truss as a 120 m beam with w = 100 kN/m. In service, simply supported at its ends, the midspan moment is M = wL²/8 = 180,000 kN·m; during lifting with lift points set 20 m inward, the moment at each lift point is M = −w·20²/2 = −20,000 kN·m and midspan becomes w·80²/8 − 20,000 = 60,000 kN·m. Near the lift points the top chord turns from compression to tension and the bottom chord into compression. Dimensions and load are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段模型分析每個提升階段（離地、提升中、就位、卸載），列出受力反號或利用率增加的桿件清單，逐一檢查挫屈與連接；考慮單一吊點相對高差、動力係數與提升時風載的組合，必要時加設臨時桿件或改變吊點位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyse every lifting stage (lift-off, travel, arrival, release) in the construction-stage model, list members whose force changes sign or whose utilisation rises, and check each for buckling and connections; combine a relative level difference at one lift point, a dynamic factor and wind during lifting, adding temporary members or moving lift points if necessary.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 桁架等效為長 120 m、w = 100 kN/m 的梁。使用狀態兩端簡支，跨中 M = wL²/8 = 180,000 kN·m；提升時吊點各內縮 20 m，吊點處負彎矩 M = −w·20²/2 = −20,000 kN·m，跨中變為 w·80²/8 − 20,000 = 60,000 kN·m。吊點附近上弦由受壓轉為受拉、下弦轉為受壓。尺寸與荷載為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Treat the truss as a 120 m beam with w = 100 kN/m. In service, simply supported at its ends, the midspan moment is M = wL²/8 = 180,000 kN·m; during lifting with lift points set 20 m inward, the moment at each lift point is M = −w·20²/2 = −20,000 kN·m and midspan becomes w·80²/8 − 20,000 = 60,000 kN·m. Near the lift points the top chord turns from compression to tension and the bottom chord into compression. Dimensions and load are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lifting state versus service state", which statement holds?
options: 桁架等效為長 120 m、w = 100 kN/m 的梁。
同步提升的精度越高越好，允差可以任意設得很小而不影響施工。
計算重量已經很精確，試提升只是形式。
optionsEn: Treat the truss as a 120 m beam with w = 100 kN/m.
The more precise synchronous lifting is the better, and the tolerance can be set arbitrarily tight without affecting the work.
The calculated weight is already precise, so a trial lift is a formality.
quiz.explanation: 桁架等效為長 120 m、w = 100 kN/m 的梁。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Treat the truss as a 120 m beam with w = 100 kN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lifting state versus service state: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「提升點與受力反轉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lift points and force reversal” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段模型分析每個提升階段（離地、提升中、就位、卸載），列出受力反號或利用率增加的桿件清單，逐一檢查挫屈與連接；考慮單一吊點相對高差、動力係數與提升時風載的組合，必要時加設臨時桿件或改變吊點位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse every lifting stage (lift-off, travel, arrival, release) in the construction-stage model, list members whose force changes sign or whose utilisation rises, and check each for buckling and connections; combine a relative level difference at one lift point, a dynamic factor and wind during lifting, adding temporary members or moving lift points if necessary. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構計算書要有獨立的提升階段章節，列出每個階段的支承條件、荷載組合、受力反號桿件與臨時加固；未經設計者核可，不得在現場自行改變吊點位置或增減提升單元的範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural calculations need a separate lifting-stage chapter listing support conditions, load combinations, members with reversed force and temporary strengthening for each stage; lift-point positions and the extent of lifting units must not be changed on site without the designer's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只按使用狀態設計桁架，提升時吊點附近原為受拉的細長斜桿受壓挫屈，桁架局部失穩；這類事故往往發生在離地瞬間或吊點高差突然增大時，後果是整個提升單元變形甚至墜落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A truss designed for service alone can see slender diagonals near lift points, intended for tension, buckle in compression during lifting and destabilise locally; such incidents often occur at lift-off or when a lift-point level difference suddenly grows, deforming or even dropping the whole lifting unit. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段模型分析每個提升階段（離地、提升中、就位、卸載），列出受力反號或利用率增加的桿件清單，逐一檢查挫屈與連接；考慮單一吊點相對高差、動力係數與提升時風載的組合，必要時加設臨時桿件或改變吊點位置。
knowledge.textEn: Analyse every lifting stage (lift-off, travel, arrival, release) in the construction-stage model, list members whose force changes sign or whose utilisation rises, and check each for buckling and connections; combine a relative level difference at one lift point, a dynamic factor and wind during lifting, adding temporary members or moving lift points if necessary.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構計算書要有獨立的提升階段章節，列出每個階段的支承條件、荷載組合、受力反號桿件與臨時加固；未經設計者核可，不得在現場自行改變吊點位置或增減提升單元的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: The structural calculations need a separate lifting-stage chapter listing support conditions, load combinations, members with reversed force and temporary strengthening for each stage; lift-point positions and the extent of lifting units must not be changed on site without the designer's approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lifting state versus service state"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以施工階段模型分析每個提升階段（離地、提升中、就位、卸載），列出受力反號或利用率增加的桿件清單，逐一檢查挫屈與連接。
提升到位就代表工作完成，千斤頂可以直接拆除。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Analyse every lifting stage (lift-off, travel, arrival, release) in the construction-stage model, list members whose force changes sign or whose utilisation rises, and check each for buckling and connections.
Once the unit reaches position the work is done and the jacks can simply be removed.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段模型分析每個提升階段（離地、提升中、就位、卸載），列出受力反號或利用率增加的桿件清單，逐一檢查挫屈與連接；考慮單一吊點相對高差、動力係數與提升時風載的組合，必要時加設臨時桿件或改變吊點位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Analyse every lifting stage (lift-off, travel, arrival, release) in the construction-stage model, list members whose force changes sign or whose utilisation rises, and check each for buckling and connections; combine a relative level difference at one lift point, a dynamic factor and wind during lifting, adding temporary members or moving lift points if necessary. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lifting state versus service state: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「提升點與受力反轉」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift points and force reversal” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只按使用狀態設計桁架，提升時吊點附近原為受拉的細長斜桿受壓挫屈，桁架局部失穩；這類事故往往發生在離地瞬間或吊點高差突然增大時，後果是整個提升單元變形甚至墜落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A truss designed for service alone can see slender diagonals near lift points, intended for tension, buckle in compression during lifting and destabilise locally; such incidents often occur at lift-off or when a lift-point level difference suddenly grows, deforming or even dropping the whole lifting unit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：所以每一個提升階段都要把結構當成一個新的結構系統來分析，包括動力係數、吊點不同步與風載，而不是只看最終狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every lifting stage must therefore be analysed as a new structural system, including dynamic factors, unsynchronised lift points and wind, rather than checking the final state alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只按使用狀態設計桁架，提升時吊點附近原為受拉的細長斜桿受壓挫屈，桁架局部失穩；這類事故往往發生在離地瞬間或吊點高差突然增大時，後果是整個提升單元變形甚至墜落。
knowledge.textEn: A truss designed for service alone can see slender diagonals near lift points, intended for tension, buckle in compression during lifting and destabilise locally; such incidents often occur at lift-off or when a lift-point level difference suddenly grows, deforming or even dropping the whole lifting unit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lifting state versus service state" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
吊耳只是臨時配件，隨便焊上去就可以。
只按使用狀態設計桁架，提升時吊點附近原為受拉的細長斜桿受壓挫屈，桁架局部失穩；這類事故往往發生在離地瞬間或吊點高差突然增大時，後果是整個提升單元變形甚至墜落。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way.
A truss designed for service alone can see slender diagonals near lift points, intended for tension, buckle in compression during lifting and destabilise locally.
quiz.explanation: 只按使用狀態設計桁架，提升時吊點附近原為受拉的細長斜桿受壓挫屈，桁架局部失穩；這類事故往往發生在離地瞬間或吊點高差突然增大時，後果是整個提升單元變形甚至墜落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A truss designed for service alone can see slender diagonals near lift points, intended for tension, buckle in compression during lifting and destabilise locally; such incidents often occur at lift-off or when a lift-point level difference suddenly grows, deforming or even dropping the whole lifting unit. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
